translations.web: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever:
translations.bsb: And I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Advocate to be with you forever—
translations.kjv: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;
